title: Ascent Follow-Along
description: A woman in an orange jumpsuit climbs a metal staircase attached to a decaying, poster-covered building. Above her, a large weathered sign reads 'FEATURE REEL - ASCENT - FOLLOW-ALONG' while another figure is visible inside a lit window, with a long snake-like object hanging down.
prompt: A dramatic cinematic scene of a woman wearing an orange jumpsuit and goggles climbing an external metal staircase on a decaying multi-story building covered in torn posters and graffiti. A large weathered rooftop sign reads 'FEATURE REEL - ASCENT - FOLLOW-ALONG'. Another figure is visible through a lit window with a long snake-like object hanging down. Dramatic sunset sky with glowing orange light beams cutting through dark clouds, moody dystopian atmosphere.
